CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_EMPLOYER_SEC
AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_Employer AS 
(
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5', BST.COMPNAME),1) AS EmployerId
	,BST.COMPNAME AS EmployerName
	,NULL AS LocationId
	,NULL AS EmployerTelephoneNumber
	,NULL AS EmployerFaxNumber
	,NULL AS EmployerEmailAddress
	,NULL AS EmployerUsFederalEmployerId
	,NULL AS PartyId
	,NULL AS DunsNumber
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetHeadquarters
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetBranch
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetDivision
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetSubsidiary
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetParent
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetUltimate
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
	,NULL AS AnzsicClassCode
	,NULL AS SectorCode
	,NULL AS SicIndustryCode
	,NULL AS SmeClassCode
	,NULL AS Subsector
	,NULL AS EmployerAddress1
	,NULL AS EmployerAddress2
	,NULL AS EmployerAddress3
	,NULL AS EmployerAddress4
	,NULL AS CityId
	,NULL AS StateId
	,NULL AS ZipCode
	,NULL AS Country
	,NULL AS EmployerCodeOccupationLegal
	,BST.BUSNATURE AS BusinessNature
	,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine1
	,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine2
	,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine3
	,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine4
	,NULL AS EmployerCodeTopCompany
	,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BST.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BST.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
    ,BSTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BST ON BSTD.CLTCODE = BST.CLTCODE AND BST.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_Employer FROM TMP_BNKM_Employer;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_Employer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
EmployerId
,EmployerName
,BusinessNature
)) HASHROW, EmployerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_Employer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TMP_BNKM_Employer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
EmployerId
,EmployerName
,BusinessNature
)) HASHROW, EmployerId
FROM BNKM.Employer --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'SEC'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.EmployerId,TGT.EmployerId) AS EmployerId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_Employer_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_Employer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
	[EmployerId] = SRC.EmployerId
	,[EmployerName] = SRC.EmployerName
	,[LocationId] = NULL
	,[EmployerTelephoneNumber] = NULL
	,[EmployerFaxNumber] = NULL
	,[EmployerEmailAddress] = NULL
	,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId] = NULL
	,[PartyId] = NULL
	,[DunsNumber] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetBranch] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetDivision] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetParent] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetUltimate] = NULL
	,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate] = NULL
	,[AnzsicClassCode] = NULL
	,[SectorCode] = NULL
	,[SicIndustryCode] = NULL
	,[SmeClassCode] = NULL
	,[Subsector] = NULL
	,[EmployerAddress1] = NULL
	,[EmployerAddress2] = NULL
	,[EmployerAddress3] = NULL
	,[EmployerAddress4] = NULL
	,[CityId] = NULL
	,[StateId] = NULL
	,[ZipCode] = NULL
	,[Country] = NULL
	,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal] = NULL
	,[BusinessNature] = SRC.BusinessNature
	,[EmployerAddressLine1] = NULL
	,[EmployerAddressLine2] = NULL
	,[EmployerAddressLine3] = NULL
	,[EmployerAddressLine4] = NULL
	,[EmployerCodeTopCompany] = NULL
	,[SourceSystemCode] = 'SRC'
	,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,[WorkFlowId] = 0
	,[TaskRunId] = 0
	,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Employer TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_Employer SRC ON SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId ;


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.Employer
(
	EmployerId
	,EmployerName
	,LocationId
	,EmployerTelephoneNumber
	,EmployerFaxNumber
	,EmployerEmailAddress
	,EmployerUsFederalEmployerId
	,PartyId
	,DunsNumber
	,DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
	,DunBradstreetHeadquarters
	,DunBradstreetBranch
	,DunBradstreetDivision
	,DunBradstreetSubsidiary
	,DunBradstreetParent
	,DunBradstreetUltimate
	,DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
	,AnzsicClassCode
	,SectorCode
	,SicIndustryCode
	,SmeClassCode
	,Subsector
	,EmployerAddress1
	,EmployerAddress2
	,EmployerAddress3
	,EmployerAddress4
	,CityId
	,StateId
	,ZipCode
	,Country
	,EmployerCodeOccupationLegal
	,BusinessNature
	,EmployerAddressLine1
	,EmployerAddressLine2
	,EmployerAddressLine3
	,EmployerAddressLine4
	,EmployerCodeTopCompany
	,SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm 
)
SELECT
     EmployerId AS EmployerId
	,EmployerName AS EmployerName
	,NULL AS LocationId
	,NULL AS EmployerTelephoneNumber
	,NULL AS EmployerFaxNumber
	,NULL AS EmployerEmailAddress
	,NULL AS EmployerUsFederalEmployerId
	,NULL AS PartyId
	,NULL AS DunsNumber
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetHeadquarters
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetBranch
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetDivision
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetSubsidiary
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetParent
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetUltimate
	,NULL AS DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
	,NULL AS AnzsicClassCode
	,NULL AS SectorCode
	,NULL AS SicIndustryCode
	,NULL AS SmeClassCode
	,NULL AS Subsector
	,NULL AS EmployerAddress1
	,NULL AS EmployerAddress2
	,NULL AS EmployerAddress3
	,NULL AS EmployerAddress4
	,NULL AS CityId
	,NULL AS StateId
	,NULL AS ZipCode
	,NULL AS Country
	,NULL AS EmployerCodeOccupationLegal
	,BusinessNature AS BusinessNature
	,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine1
	,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine2
	,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine3
	,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine4
	,NULL AS EmployerCodeTopCompany
	,'SEC' AS SourceSystemCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_Employer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_Employer;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA;

END
